home.title: Welcome to WinRice
home.subtitle: Customize Windows 11 with one click, and always be able to go back.
home.buildChangedHint: Some tools may stop working after a Windows update. Check the Compatibility tab of the tools you use.

settings.modeHint: Shortcut: Ctrl + Shift + L toggles light and dark.
settings.emergency: Emergency shortcut: Ctrl + Alt + Shift + R undoes the last change from anywhere.
settings.accentFromTheme: Use the accent color of the applied theme

restore.title: Restore original Windows
restore.text: Turns off every tool, puts back the original version of every config file WinRice changed, and removes the lines it added.
restore.uninstall: Also uninstall the tools WinRice installed

tool.noToggle: This tool has no on/off switch
tool.adminHint: Installing this tool asks Windows for administrator permission.
tool.paidHint: Paid software: it works as a free trial, then needs a license.
tool.restrictedHint: Free to use, but the license restricts some uses (such as commercial use). Read it before using at work.
tool.incompatibleHint: This tool does not support your Windows version (build {build}), so it cannot be installed or turned on.
tool.settingsHint: Simple options. WinRice backs up the config file before changing it. Comments inside YAML files are not kept.

plan.intro: This is what WinRice is going to do. If any step fails, everything already done is undone automatically.
plan.safety: Your original files are backed up first.
plan.failedRolledBack: Something failed and all changes were undone. {error}

step.add_profile_block: Add a few lines to your PowerShell profile for {tool}
step.remove_profile_block: Remove the lines {tool} added to your PowerShell profile
step.restore_originals: Put back the original version of every config file WinRice changed
step.set_config_value: Change one option in the config file of {tool}

errors.not_toggleable: This tool has no on/off switch.
errors.conflict: It cannot run together with: {ids}. Turn those off first.
errors.unsupported_method: Install method "{method}" is not supported yet.
errors.incompatible: This tool does not support your Windows version.
errors.no_config: This tool has no config file to change.
errors.unsupported_format: This config file format is not supported yet.
errors.forbidden_file: A theme cannot contain this kind of file: {ids}.
errors.unsafe_path: Unsafe file path in the theme: {ids}.
errors.missing_file: The theme refers to a file that is missing: {ids}.
errors.invalid_theme_id: The theme id is not valid.
errors.components_conflict: The theme uses tools that cannot run together: {ids}.
errors.tool_without_config: This tool has no config file: {ids}.
errors.binary_config: A config file must be text: {ids}.
errors.repo_too_large: That repository is too big to import.
errors.theme_id_taken: An official theme already uses this name.
errors.hash_mismatch: A downloaded file did not match its checksum: {ids}.
errors.corrupt_journal: The undo information for this theme is damaged.
errors.invalid_profile_name: Use a name with up to 60 characters.
errors.invalid_shortcut: That shortcut is not valid. Example: Super+Alt+W.
errors.shortcut_in_use: Another program is already using that shortcut.
errors.not_undoable: This change can no longer be undone. Only the newest change can.
errors.unknown_entry: That history entry no longer exists.
errors.nothing_to_recolor: None of your tools can be recolored by this palette.
errors.no_palette: This theme has no color palette.
errors.already_official: This theme is already in the official library.
errors.submission_has_errors: Fix the items marked with ✕ first.
errors.url_not_allowed: That link cannot be opened from here.
errors.cover_too_large: The screenshot is bigger than 2 MB.

trial.title: Keep {name} on?
trial.hint: If you do nothing, everything goes back to how it was. Emergency shortcut: Ctrl + Alt + Shift + R.

reverted.timeout: Time ran out, so {tool} was reverted.
reverted.watchdog: Windows Explorer kept crashing, so {tool} was turned off automatically.

compat.needs: This tool needs build {min} or newer.
compat.max: It was tested up to build {max}.

catalog.title: Catalog updates
catalog.text: Download new tools and themes from the official catalog, without updating WinRice. Every file is verified before it is used.

empty.imported: No imported themes yet. Paste a GitHub link below.
empty.mine: You have not saved a theme yet. Turn some tools on and save your setup below.
empty.favorites: No favorites yet. Open a theme and press the star.

themes.unverifiedHint: Imported from the internet and not reviewed. Read what it will do before applying.
themes.incompatibleHint: This theme needs Windows build {build} or newer.
themes.importHint: Paste the link of a GitHub repository (or a folder inside one) that has a theme.yaml. Only data files are accepted, never programs or scripts.
themes.saveTitle: Save my current setup as a theme
themes.saveHint: Collects the config files of the tools that are on now. PowerShell profiles are never copied.
themes.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}" from this computer? Tools it installed are not removed.
themes.componentsHint: Untick what you do not want. The theme is applied all at once: if something fails, everything is undone.
themes.missingRequired: Without {names} the theme will not look as designed.
themes.reviewHint: The list above is exactly what will be done. Your original files are backed up, and you can undo the whole theme later.

will.incompatible: Not compatible with your Windows: it will be skipped.
will.mods: {n} Windhawk mod(s) are listed but not applied yet; add them in Windhawk.
will.nothing: Already set up. Nothing to do.

themes.syncText: Recolor the tools you already use with this theme's palette, without changing anything else. You can undo it from the History.
themes.syncNone: None of your installed tools has a color option that maps to this palette yet.

widget.noTools: No installed tools with a switch yet. Install some from the Tools page.
widget.careHint: Needs administrator permission or restarts parts of Windows
widget.confirmCare: {name} may ask for administrator permission or restart parts of Windows. Continue?
widget.pausedHint: {n} tool(s) are paused and will come back when you resume.
widget.confirmRestore: Turn everything off and restore the original files?
widget.doneSkipped: Done. Skipped (not installed or no switch): {names}.
widget.sensorsHint: Reading temperatures, fan speed and GPU load needs administrator permission through a helper that is not installed yet.

widgetCfg.title: Quick-access widget
widgetCfg.text: A small panel with quick toggles, profiles and live hardware information. Nothing leaves your computer.
widgetCfg.closeToTray: Keep WinRice in the tray when the main window is closed
widgetCfg.shortcut: Shortcut to show or hide the floating widget
widgetCfg.toolsHint: Tick the tools to show and use the arrows to change their order.
widgetCfg.tempHint: Leave empty for no alert. Temperature alerts only work once the sensor helper is available.

profiles.text: A profile remembers which tools are on. Switch between them with one click, here or in the widget.
profiles.pauseText: Turns everything off for a while (games, presentations, screen sharing) and remembers what was on.
profiles.pausedText: These will come back when you resume: {names}.
profiles.newTitle: Save current setup as a profile
profiles.name: Profile name (for example Work or Games)

submit.title: Send to the official library
submit.text: Share this theme with everyone. A guided check makes sure it meets the rules, then prepares the files and the text for your pull request.
submit.name: Theme name
submit.coverHint: Take a screenshot of your desktop with the theme on and give the path of the file (png, jpg or webp, up to 2 MB).
submit.how1: Create a GitHub account if you do not have one and open the project page.
submit.how2: Fork the repository (button "Fork" at the top right).
submit.how3: In your fork, upload the folder catalog/themes/<your theme> from the folder above.
submit.how4: Open a pull request and paste the text of PULL_REQUEST.md. The checks run automatically.

issue.id_taken: An official theme already uses this id. Rename your theme.
issue.author_github_missing: Add your GitHub username so you get credit.
issue.license_not_open: Choose an open license (for example MIT). The library only accepts open licenses.
issue.description_lang_missing: The description must be written in English and Portuguese.
issue.tools_invalid: The theme uses a tool that is not in the catalog or tools that cannot run together.
issue.no_palette: No color palette. Not required, but themes with one can recolor other tools.
issue.review_configs: Check that your config files do not contain personal data (user names, paths, tokens).

toggle.title: One switch per tool
toggle.text: Every tool has a switch. Turning it on installs what is needed, backs up your files first and shows you exactly what will change.

try.title: Try before you keep
try.text: Use "Try for 30 seconds": the change is real, but if you do not confirm it, everything goes back by itself. Emergency shortcut: Ctrl + Alt + Shift + R.

restore.title: You can always go back
restore.text: Every change can be undone, and "Restore original Windows" puts everything back as it was. New here? Start with a beginner theme.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.text: Plain-language meaning of the technical words you will see in WinRice.
